scope: Pre-PR snapshot of fresh adapter-promotion review, combining lead scope review with independently produced credential/transport review. No code blockers found; verdict pauses only for not-yet-run GitHub CI. Final gate closure must be recorded against the exact PR head before merge. Exact paths and hashes are in verification.json.
checked_surfaces: Lead read all nine package files, current Bedrock origin/main orientation, complete workflow, full HEB-127 promotion criteria and origin DDR-002.
Independent clean-context reviewer read whole package, model/GraphQL contracts, tests and original verification evidence; no blockers.
Independent reviewer reran 45 tests, all ten schema documents and valid/malformed/Unicode/deep-error controls; failures surfaced unknown mutation outcomes with one request.

Lead export/source comparison: eight files unchanged; only README portability/link edits. New workflow uses pinned existing actions, read-only token, no credentials/live API, bounded verification job.
Origin HEX tests reconsume the separately installed extracted wheel without source import. Package name retained for API compatibility.
Fourteen-path allowlist excludes deferred runtime, native tools, credential helpers and installed plugin changes. Origin design and evidence remain immutable links instead of copies.
